units.source_text: 源氏公子谪居须磨时，做了那个清楚的梦之后，

en.t: After Prince Genji had that vivid dream while he was living in exile at Suma,

units.source_text: 心中常常挂念已故的桐壶上皇，屡屡忧愁叹息，

en.t: he often thought of the late Kiritsubo Retired Emperor and repeatedly sighed in sorrow,

units.source_text: 总想做些佛事，以拯救父皇在阴世受罪之苦。

en.t: always wishing to perform Buddhist rites to relieve his father emperor from suffering in the world of the dead.

units.source_text: 现在他已归京，便赶紧准备超荐。

en.t: Now that he had returned to the capital, he hurried to prepare memorial rites for the dead.

units.source_text: 就在十月中举办法华八讲。

en.t: In the middle of the tenth month, he held the eight lectures on the Lotus Sutra.

units.source_text: 世人对源氏公子的倾慕，全同从前一样。

en.t: The admiration people felt for Prince Genji was exactly as it had been before.
The Empress Dowager's illness remained grave.

units.source_text: 她无法摈斥源氏公子，心中甚是不乐。

en.t: Unable to drive Prince Genji away, she was deeply displeased at heart.

units.source_text: 朱雀帝呢，以前违背了父皇遗命，常恐身受恶报。

en.t: As for Emperor Suzaku, because he had once gone against his father's dying command, he had always feared that punishment would fall upon him.

units.source_text: 如今已经遵命召回源氏，心中便觉快慰。

en.t: Now that he had obeyed the command and summoned Genji back, he felt relieved in his heart.

units.source_text: 他的眼疾以前常常发作，如今也痊愈了。

en.t: The eye ailment that had often troubled him before had now also healed.

units.source_text: 然而他总担心自己不能长生，这皇位不能久居。

en.t: Yet he still worried that he would not live long and could not remain on the throne for much longer.

units.source_text: 因此常常宣召源氏公子入宫，同他商量国事。

en.t: For that reason, he often summoned Prince Genji to the palace and discussed affairs of state with him.

units.source_text: 他毫无顾虑，把一切政务向源氏公子谘询。

en.t: Without any hesitation, he consulted Prince Genji about every matter of government.

units.source_text: 现今他可以依照自己意旨而发号施令了。

en.t: Now he could issue orders and commands according to his own wishes.

units.source_text: 因此世间一切臣民，也都欢喜赞善。

en.t: Therefore all the subjects throughout the realm rejoiced and praised him.
